Objective. Research-based. Credible. Information and tools you can use every day to improve your life. These resources are brought to you by the Cooperative Extension System and your Local Institution.

More than 50 extension horse specialists from around the country including teaching and research faculty, veterinarians, and professional extension staff from leading universities work together to provide horse enthusiasts with research based, reliable horse resources. Internet users can interact with these experts to obtain customized answers to their questions by asking a question, joining a webinar, or taking an online credit course.  


Partners: 
My Horse University, (http://www.myhorseuniversity.com )
American Youth Horse Council, (http://ayhc.com/)
